source.company_summary: BUSINESS Kulicke and Soffa Industries, Inc. (“K&S,” “we,” “us,” “our,” or the “Company”) is a global leader in semiconductor assembly technology, advancing device performance across automotive, compute, industrial, memory and communications markets.
core_technologies: Typical applications include complementary metal-oxide semiconductor (CMOS)
AT Premier PLUS for wafer level wire bonding for micro-electro-mechanical systems (MEMS)
UCLA Center for Heterogeneous Integration and Performance Scaling (CHIPS)
We have developed and implemented a global Business Continuity Management Plan (BCP)

translation.company_summary: 業務 Kulicke and Soffa Industries, Inc.（簡稱“K&S”、“我們”或“公司”）是半導體封裝技術的全球領導者，推進汽車、運算、工業、記憶體與通訊市場的裝置效能。
core_technologies: 典型應用包括互補式金氧半導體 (CMOS)
用於微機電系統 (MEMS) 的晶圓級線材鍵合的 AT Premier PLUS
UCLA 聚合整合與效能擴展中心 (CHIPS)
我們已制定並實施全球營運持續管理計畫 (BCP)
